From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>

Subject: PHI operations clarifications & next steps for MedicoRe

Hi Janelle — thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap and a few clarifying asks so we can scope the right hosting path and BAA: 

Summary of what we heard on the call:
- MedicoRe will be using the model for clinical note summarization and patient triage routing (short text + structured metadata).
- You expect the system to touch PHI at the patient-identifiable level (names, MRNs) during inference but want to avoid long-term storage of raw PHI where possible.
- Preferred initial deployment: lean toward hosted API for speed, but legal/IT require clarity on BAA availability and whether a Dedicated or Private deployment will be mandated if certain PHI flows are required.

Clarifying questions (can you confirm?):
1) Scope of PHI we should assume: will any unstructured documents (full clinical notes, scanned PDFs) be passed to the API, or only short snippets/structured fields?
2) Retention expectations: do you require zero retention of request/response bodies (no logs) vs. shorter retention (30/90 days) for debugging?
3) Encryption/KMS: do you need customer-managed keys (HSM/KMS) for any stored artifacts?
4) SOC 2: is an in-scope SOC 2 Type II report required before pilot? If yes, which trust services categories are critical (security, availability, confidentiality)?

Attached: Redwood_BAA_summary.pdf (one-pager on our standard BAA options and where they map to Hosted / Dedicated / Private). Also attaching a Vendor_Security_Questionnaire.docx placeholder — if you want, we can populate the questionnaire ourselves and return the completed copy.

Next steps I propose: 
- Janelle: confirm answers to Q1–Q3 and flag any legal requirements (Laura on the thread).
- Ben: flag whether we can offer pilot-level BAA on Hosted while SOC2 is finalizing, or if Dedicated/Private will be mandatory.
- Marissa: prepare SOC2 artifact checklist we can share with MedicoRe IT.

If you can send the security questionnaire back, we’ll return a completed copy + timeline (target 5 business days for first pass).

Thanks — Rafael
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192

Cc: Laura Chen <l.chen@medicore.com>, MedicoRe IT <it@medicore.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 09:02:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: PHI operations clarifications & next steps for MedicoRe

Rafael — thanks for the clear recap. Confirming on behalf of MedicoRe: 

Answers to your questions:
1) Scope: pilot will include short clinical note snippets (few paragraphs) and structured fields (patient id, encounter id). We will NOT send full scanned PDFs in pilot. We do plan to evaluate full notes later in 2027, but that is out of scope for the initial engagement.
2) Retention: Legal prefers no storage of raw request/response bodies in production. For the pilot we can accept short-term logs (30 days) for debugging but these must be deletable on request and access controlled.
3) KMS: We prefer customer-managed keys for any persisted artifacts; however if Hosted can guarantee no persistent storage of PHI, we can be flexible.
4) SOC 2: Type II in-scope for Security and Confidentiality is required before GA; pilot can proceed while SOC2 is in progress if we have interim evidence (system design, SOC2 readiness doc).

We’ve attached our internal vendor security questionnaire — it’s the same template our procurement uses. Laura (cc’d) will chime in on legal specifics.

Can you also confirm your standard BAA variants (we saw the one-pager) — specifically whether Hosted + BAA is an option or if Dedicated is required given our KMS preference.

Thanks,
Janelle Ortiz
Head of Product Ops | MedicoRe
janelle@medicore.com | +1 617-555-0218

Marissa/Ben — forwarding Janelle’s reply and the completed questionnaire they attached. Action items: 

- Ben: can we provisionally support Hosted + BAA with strict non-retention and customer-managed KMS for persisted artifacts? If Hosted cannot support customer KMS, outline the minimum triggers that would push MedicoRe to Dedicated/Private (e.g., requirement for HSM-backed KMS, continuous storage of PHI). Also flag any timeline constraints for getting a pilot BAA in place (legal review windows).
- Marissa: please compile the SOC2 artifacts we can share immediately (system architecture, dataflow diagrams, encryption controls, access controls). Janelle asked for interim evidence; we should have a one-page SOC2 readiness summary and a few artifact links.

Target: return completed questionnaire + SOC2 readiness note to MedicoRe by EOD Friday (2026-12-04). Ben, please confirm if that timeline is feasible for the BAA draft.

Thanks — Rafael
